interpretation: Under the frozen whole-garden validation design, adding urban cover and green-space edge density after the partial pollination/floral state did not improve transfer and instead increased held-out NLL overall. This is not evidence that urban context is biologically irrelevant or that the measured partial state is complete.

provenance.response_firewall: Model, endpoint, mapping and holdout unit were committed before project-level access to Toronto reproductive outcome values. The only repair normalized the exact four phytometer codes by case after verifying their case-insensitive identity.
